extracted.intended_audience: Wellcome grant applicants, expert reviewers, and committee members
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional guidance on confidentiality rules for Wellcome's application review process, covering expert reviews, committee discussions, what is shared with applicants, and expectations about contacting committee members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of expert reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: We ask experts to provide written expert reviews to help us decide which activities to fund. To get the best quality expert review, these reviews remain confidential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confidentiality is intended to allow reviewers to comment freely; identities will only be revealed to people directly involved in the decision making process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited disclosure of reviewer identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers’ identities will only be revealed to people directly involved in the decision making process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identity protection is a condition of the confidential review process to encourage candid feedback; reviewers should expect their identity not to be widely disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sharing unattributed review comments with applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: We usually share unattributed comments with applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicants are being interviewed, the unattributed reviews are shared to help them prepare for the interview. We may also share reviews with applicants who haven't been successful and were not interviewed to help them understand why their application wasn't supported and how they can improve future applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee discussions and paperwork are confidential
rubrics_metrics.description: The discussions, recommendations and paperwork related to all committee meetings are confidential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committee-level materials and deliberations are not publicly disclosed; confidentiality covers both spoken discussion and related documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellcome staff handle outcome communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome staff contact applicants about the outcome of their application and if the application was unsuccessful, provide them with the reasons for the decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should expect to receive decisions and explanations from Wellcome staff rather than committee members or external reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicants must not contact committee members
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants should not contact committee members about their application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All enquiries or requests for information about an application should be directed to Wellcome staff; committee members are expected to forward any such requests directly to Wellcome staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee members should forward enquiries to staff
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect committee members to forward any requests for information directly to Wellcome staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committee members should not engage directly with applicants who approach them; they act as intermediaries by redirecting enquiries to the appropriate Wellcome contact.
